title: Profile sheets configuration
description: Content for the drawing-sheet profile card (sheet 01) and contribution sheet (sheet 02).

username.description: GitHub username; used for live contributions.

name.description: Display name, set large on sheet 01.

partNumber.description: Part number shown above the name and engraved on the chip lid.

site.description: Portfolio domain shown in the top bar.

tagline.description: One or two sentences under the name; wraps to three lines max.

specs.description: Spec table rows under the tagline (max 7).

callouts.description: Leader-line labels on the chip drawing. A 'ram' callout with live commit count is added automatically.

text.description: Text before the first colon is set as the key.
